name: outcome-data-labelling
sentence: Pays 40 test USDC when labels.csv labels every item of data/items.csv, at least 90% of the 120 held-out gold items carry the gold label, no class has recall below 80% on them, and the 40 visible examples do not score more than 10 points above them; refund after 14 days
